title: Migration Spec
description:
MigrationSpec defines a custom DDL migration (01-core-basic.md §4).
Only DDL statements are allowed — DML is rejected at runtime.

ddl_by.description: DDLByDialect holds per-driver variants of the same statement, for DDL

dml.description: DML is an explicitly declared data repair, run BEFORE the DDL of the same

reason.description: Reason states why the declared DML is needed (audit trail).
examples: merge duplicate menu prices before the unique index
